stances_toward.note: Spain is one of the five EU non-recognisers that block candidate status, and its ambassador in Belgrade repeated that it defends Serbia's territorial integrity. Madrid supports the EU dialogue, takes part in EU-Western Balkans summits, and says it could follow if normalisation includes mutual recognition. The 'rival' grade is the structural block, not hostility (confidence C): Pristina's stated goal depends on Spanish consent.
